`ghostrefs.png` is the original project logo.

`ghostrefs-transparent.png` is the transparent version used by `docs/conf.py`
for both themes and the favicon. The light-theme header logo uses CSS
`filter: invert(1)`; alpha transparency is preserved.

The transparent asset was edited with the built-in ImageGen tool using this
prompt:

> Use case: background-extraction. Extract this exact logo cleanly onto a genuinely fully transparent PNG canvas. This is a website header logo and needs perfectly clean vector-like edges. Preserve the identical ghost outline, both cyan eyes, circular nodes, connection curves and purple dashed right link. Keep cyan and purple colors and exact layout. Remove the entire dark background outside AND inside the ghost and every enclosed space in the network. Make all empty regions completely transparent with alpha 0. CLEAN CUTOUT: no speckles, stray dots, grunge, flecks, dark remnants, texture, colored fringe, shadow, glow or ghost-body fill. Keep smooth clean solid strokes and circles with antialiased edges only at their boundaries. No checkerboard or background rectangle. No additions or redesign.
